asked.item: Why the log says the follow gate was skipped
Test account never gets the follow question
Automation published November 12 (after the November 10 cutoff)

verdict.reason: The help pages state that a follower confirmed within the last 30 days skips the follow gate on automations published after November 10, 2026, and how to see the gate when testing.

steps.text: On automations published after November 10, 2026, a contact Blotato confirmed as a follower within the last 30 days skips the follow gate.
A contact that passed a follow gate on the same connected account in an earlier run gets your message without being asked again.
To see the gate message while testing, comment or message from an account that has not passed a follow gate in the last 30 days.
